items.quote: Overall, we are confident of delivering 25 to 40 basis points improvement for FY '27 in opex to NTI.
items.statement: Opex to NTI to improve by 25-40 bps in FY27
items.speaker: Rajeev Jain

items.quote: By year-end we foresee 2,700 to 2,800 branches, all goes well, maybe 3,000 branches and AUM of between INR29,000 crores and INR31,000 crores, all organic.
items.statement: Gold loan AUM of INR29,000-31,000 crore and 2,700-2,800 branches by FY27 year-end
items.speaker: Rajeev Jain

items.quote: this year the digital platform will deliver INR50,000 crores of business.
items.statement: Digital platform business of INR50,000 crore in FY27
items.speaker: Rajeev Jain

items.quote: I am targeting that next year we should be delivering INR100,000 crores volume
items.statement: Digital platform volume of INR100,000 crore targeted for FY28
items.speaker: Rajeev Jain

items.quote: that moderation 10 - 15 basis points is what we foresee at this juncture, give us a quarter.
items.statement: NIM moderation of 10-15 bps expected at this juncture
items.speaker: Rajeev Jain

items.quote: The interesting thing is custom AI model, which is on track to go live in Q2.
items.statement: Custom AI model for B2B to go live in Q2FY27
items.speaker: Rajeev Jain

items.quote: There are two new lines of business that we are at this juncture planning to launch by January, February.
items.statement: Two new lines of business to launch by Jan-Feb 2027
items.speaker: Rajeev Jain

tone.label: confident
tone.why: Calls the quarter excellent and sets dated AI, digital and margin targets, while holding back on revising guidance until next quarter.
